text:
jess: Quick heads-up — Polestar private cutover is tomorrow 10:00am PT. Short async check: who still has blockers for VPC peering / air-gap image verification? Need owners for net, infra, and rollout canary.

sam: I own the VPC peering. Current blocker: their NAT GW is rejecting our BGP session when we advertise the /26. Net team asked to try /27 as workaround. Trying now, will update in 15m. @jess @chad

alex: PR #4823 is waiting for one more review (config templating for tenant isolation). @maya can you take a quick look? low-risk change. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/polestar/pulls/4823

maya: on it. Will review in the next hour. Also confirming canary criteria: 5k reqs across 3 minutes with <150ms p50 and no 5xx. Is that still the target?

jess: yes that's the canary. If we fail p50 we rollback to hosted variant automatically. chad will own the rollback signal.

chad: SRE will run the smoke and rollback. I added a short runbook snippet to the ticket. Smoke checklist:
```
- run curl against /health on internal LB
- check kv cache warmup logs: grep "KV warmed" /var/log/inference/*.log
- watch model-load time < 6s
```
I'll run the checks 10m before cutover and again immediately after traffic switch.

sam: update — BGP still flapping when we advertise /27 unless we disable TTL-security on the peer. Customer ops is OK with disabling for the cutover window. Need a thumbs from infra. @chad @jess

chad: :+1: disabled TTL-sec for the session for the window. Pushed ACL change `allow 192.0.2.0/27 from polestar` to the edge config.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: polestar/private-cutover -> 2026-03-19T17:00:00Z (canary) by jess. CI: green.

alex: FYI the config PR includes an escape hatch to pin to the hosted model if the private runtime reports >200ms p50. That's in the rollout policy section.

maya: reviewed and approved the PR. @alex can you merge and tag for the release train?

alex: merged and tagged `polestar-cutover-2026-03-19`. Noting CR-129 still pending for image-signing attestation from customer side. @jess any update?

jess: Customer security confirmed they'll provide the signed image by 09:00 PT tomorrow. If delayed, we fallback to signed image from our registry (customer approved beforehand).

sam: final network note — NAT GW metrics look stable with /27 after TTL-sec toggle. I'll monitor during preflight.

chad: I'll post post-cutover smoke logs to the ticket and run the rollback if anything trips. Everyone set for 09:40 PT preflight sync in case last-minute issues pop up. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks team — tagging this thread as the canonical async log. If anything changes ping here and also add to the ticket.

sam: copying the small iptables snippet we applied in case we need it for mitigation:
```
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE --to 198.51.100.0/27
```

chad: noted. I will run the smoke and attach logs 10:05 PT after canary traffic.

deploy-bot: canary switched -> 2026-03-19T17:05:00Z. metrics: p50=120ms, errors=0.

jess: perfect — closing async thread, will post final cutover notes in the ticket."
